iterations.xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  xmlns:tns="http://example.com/university-enrollment"
                  id="Definitions_UniversityEnrollment"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/university-enrollment">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Application" name="Application"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_MissingDocuments" name="Missing documents request"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_SupportingDocuments" name="Supporting documents"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Acceptance" name="Acceptance letter"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Rejection" name="Rejection letter"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Confirmation" name="Enrollment confirmation"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Orientation" name="Orientation materials"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Grades" name="Grades available"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_StudentStatus" name="Graduation or withdrawal notice"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_Enrollment">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_University" name="University" processRef="Process_University"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Student" name="Prospective student / student" processRef="Process_Student"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Application" sourceRef="Task_SubmitApplication" targetRef="Start_ApplicationReceived" messageRef="Message_Application"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_MissingRequest" sourceRef="Task_NotifyMissing" targetRef="Task_ReceiveMissingRequest" messageRef="Message_MissingDocuments"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Documents" sourceRef="Task_SubmitDocuments" targetRef="Task_ReceiveDocuments" messageRef="Message_SupportingDocuments"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Acceptance" sourceRef="Task_SendAcceptance" targetRef="Task_ReceiveAcceptance" messageRef="Message_Acceptance"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Rejection" sourceRef="Task_SendRejection" targetRef="Task_ReceiveRejection" messageRef="Message_Rejection"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Confirmation" sourceRef="Task_ConfirmEnrollment" targetRef="Event_ConfirmationReceived" messageRef="Message_Confirmation"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Orientation" sourceRef="Task_SendOrientation" targetRef="Task_ReceiveOrientation" messageRef="Message_Orientation"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Grades" sourceRef="Task_SendGrades" targetRef="Task_ReceiveGrades" messageRef="Message_Grades"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Graduation" sourceRef="Task_NotifyGraduation" targetRef="Task_ReceiveStudentStatus" messageRef="Message_StudentStatus"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Withdrawal" sourceRef="Task_NotifyWithdrawal" targetRef="Task_ReceiveStudentStatus" messageRef="Message_StudentStatus"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_University" name="University enrollment and academic administration" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_ApplicationReceived" name="Application received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_Application" messageRef="Message_Application"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReviewApplication" name="Review application and supporting documents"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_DocumentsComplete" name="Are all documents present?"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_NotifyMissing" name="Request missing documents" messageRef="Message_MissingDocuments"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveDocuments" name="Receive supporting documents" messageRef="Message_SupportingDocuments"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ParallelSplit" name="Evaluate application and process fees"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_EvaluateApplication" name="Evaluate application by admissions committee"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ProcessFees" name="Process application fees or waivers"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ParallelJoin" name="Evaluation and fee processing complete"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AdmissionDecision" name="Is the application accepted?"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendAcceptance" name="Send acceptance letter" messageRef="Message_Acceptance"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendRejection" name="Send rejection letter" messageRef="Message_Rejection"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Rejected" name="Application rejected"/>
    <bpmn:eventBasedGateway id="Gateway_ConfirmationOrDeadline" name="Await confirmation or enrollment deadline"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_ConfirmationReceived" name="Enrollment confirmed">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_Confirmation" messageRef="Message_Confirmation"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_Deadline" name="Enrollment deadline reached">
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition id="TimerEventDefinition_Deadline">
        <bpmn:timeDate>enrollment deadline</bpmn:timeDate>
      </bpmn:timerEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Canceled" name="Application canceled"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_SetupSplit" name="Provide orientation and set up accounts"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendOrientation" name="Send orientation materials" messageRef="Message_Orientation"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SetupAccounts" name="Set up email, online portal, and library accounts"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_SetupJoin" name="Orientation and account setup complete"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_International" name="Is the student international?"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ProcessVisa" name="Assist with visa processing"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_InternationalMerge" name="Continue enrollment"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_SemesterEnd" name="End of semester">
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition id="TimerEventDefinition_Semester">
        <bpmn:timeCycle>each semester</bpmn:timeCycle>
      </bpmn:timerEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PostGrades" name="Post grades"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendGrades" name="Make grades available online" messageRef="Message_Grades"/>
    <bpmn:eventBasedGateway id="Gateway_NextSemesterOrExit" name="Await next semester or student exit"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveStudentStatus" name="Receive graduation or withdrawal notice" messageRef="Message_StudentStatus"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_StudentExit" name="Student graduated or withdrew"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_U1" sourceRef="Start_ApplicationReceived" targetRef="Task_ReviewApplication"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_U2" sourceRef="Task_ReviewApplication" targetRef="Gateway_DocumentsComplete"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_U3" sourceRef="Gateway_DocumentsComplete" targetRef="Task_NotifyMissing">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${documentsMissing}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_U4" sourceRef="Task_NotifyMissing" targetRef="Task_ReceiveDocuments"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_U5" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveDocuments" targetRef="Task_ReviewApplication"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_U6" sourceRef="Gateway_DocumentsComplete" targetRef="Gateway_ParallelSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_U7" sourceRef="Gateway_ParallelSplit" targetRef="Task_EvaluateApplication"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_U8" sourceRef="Gateway_ParallelSplit" targetRef="Task_ProcessFees"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_U9" sourceRef="Task_EvaluateApplication" targetRef="Gateway_ParallelJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_U10" sourceRef="Task_ProcessFees" targetRef="Gateway_ParallelJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_U11" sourceRef="Gateway_ParallelJoin" targetRef="Gateway_AdmissionDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_U12" sourceRef="Gateway_AdmissionDecision" targetRef="Task_SendAcceptance">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${accepted}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_U13" sourceRef="Gateway_AdmissionDecision" targetRef="Task_SendRejection"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_U14" sourceRef="Task_SendRejection" targetRef="End_Rejected"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_U15" sourceRef="Task_SendAcceptance" targetRef="Gateway_ConfirmationOrDeadline"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_U16" sourceRef="Gateway_ConfirmationOrDeadline" targetRef="Event_ConfirmationReceived"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_U17" sourceRef="Gateway_ConfirmationOrDeadline" targetRef="Event_Deadline"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_U18" sourceRef="Event_Deadline" targetRef="End_Canceled"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_U19" sourceRef="Event_ConfirmationReceived" targetRef="Gateway_SetupSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_U20" sourceRef="Gateway_SetupSplit" targetRef="Task_SendOrientation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_U21" sourceRef="Gateway_SetupSplit" targetRef="Task_SetupAccounts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_U22" sourceRef="Task_SendOrientation" targetRef="Gateway_SetupJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_U23" sourceRef="Task_SetupAccounts" targetRef="Gateway_SetupJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_U24" sourceRef="Gateway_SetupJoin" targetRef="Gateway_International"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_U25" sourceRef="Gateway_International" targetRef="Task_ProcessVisa">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${internationalStudent}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_U26" sourceRef="Gateway_International" targetRef="Gateway_InternationalMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_U27" sourceRef="Task_ProcessVisa" targetRef="Gateway_InternationalMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_U28" sourceRef="Gateway_InternationalMerge" targetRef="Event_SemesterEnd"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_U29" sourceRef="Event_SemesterEnd" targetRef="Task_PostGrades"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_U30" sourceRef="Task_PostGrades" targetRef="Task_SendGrades"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_U31" sourceRef="Task_SendGrades" targetRef="Gateway_NextSemesterOrExit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_U32" sourceRef="Gateway_NextSemesterOrExit" targetRef="Event_SemesterEnd"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_U33" sourceRef="Gateway_NextSemesterOrExit" targetRef="Task_ReceiveStudentStatus"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_U34" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveStudentStatus" targetRef="End_StudentExit"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Student" name="Student enrollment and study" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_ProspectiveStudent" name="Prospective student begins application"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SubmitApplication" name="Submit application online" messageRef="Message_Application"/>
    <bpmn:eventBasedGateway id="Gateway_AwaitAdmissionResponse" name="Await document request or admission decision"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveMissingRequest" name="Receive missing documents request" messageRef="Message_MissingDocuments"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SubmitDocuments" name="Submit missing documents" messageRef="Message_SupportingDocuments"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveAcceptance" name="Receive acceptance letter" messageRef="Message_Acceptance"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveRejection" name="Receive rejection letter" messageRef="Message_Rejection"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_StudentRejected" name="Application rejected"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ConfirmEnrollment" name="Confirm enrollment by the deadline" messageRef="Message_Confirmation"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveOrientation" name="Receive orientation materials" messageRef="Message_Orientation"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ObtainID" name="Obtain student ID card"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_MeetAdvisor" name="Meet with an academic advisor"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SelectCourses" name="Select courses"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ResolveConflicts" name="Resolve schedule conflicts"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AttendClasses" name="Begin attending classes"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AddDrop" name="Add or drop courses during the add/drop period"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveGrades" name="Review grades online" messageRef="Message_Grades"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Appeal" name="Does the student have a grievance?"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SubmitAppeal" name="Submit an appeal form"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_MeetAppealsCommittee" name="Meet with the appeals committee"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AwaitAppealDecision" name="Await an appeal decision"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_StudentStatus" name="Graduate, withdraw, or continue?"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_NotifyGraduation" name="Notify university of graduation" messageRef="Message_StudentStatus"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_NotifyWithdrawal" name="Notify university of withdrawal" messageRef="Message_StudentStatus"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Graduated" name="Student graduates"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Withdrawn" name="Student withdraws"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_S1" sourceRef="Start_ProspectiveStudent" targetRef="Task_SubmitApplication"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_S2" sourceRef="Task_SubmitApplication" targetRef="Gateway_AwaitAdmissionResponse"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_S3" sourceRef="Gateway_AwaitAdmissionResponse" targetRef="Task_ReceiveMissingRequest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_S4" sourceRef="Gateway_AwaitAdmissionResponse" targetRef="Task_ReceiveAcceptance"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_S5" sourceRef="Gateway_AwaitAdmissionResponse" targetRef="Task_ReceiveRejection"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_S6" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveMissingRequest" targetRef="Task_SubmitDocuments"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_S7" sourceRef="Task_SubmitDocuments" targetRef="Gateway_AwaitAdmissionResponse"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_S8" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveRejection" targetRef="End_StudentRejected"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_S9" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveAcceptance" targetRef="Task_ConfirmEnrollment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_S10" sourceRef="Task_ConfirmEnrollment" targetRef="Task_ReceiveOrientation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_S11" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveOrientation" targetRef="Task_ObtainID"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_S12" sourceRef="Task_ObtainID" targetRef="Task_MeetAdvisor"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_S13" sourceRef="Task_MeetAdvisor" targetRef="Task_SelectCourses"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_S14" sourceRef="Task_SelectCourses" targetRef="Task_ResolveConflicts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_S15" sourceRef="Task_ResolveConflicts" targetRef="Task_AttendClasses"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_S16" sourceRef="Task_AttendClasses" targetRef="Task_AddDrop"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_S17" sourceRef="Task_AddDrop" targetRef="Task_ReceiveGrades"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_S18" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveGrades" targetRef="Gateway_Appeal"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_S19" sourceRef="Gateway_Appeal" targetRef="Task_SubmitAppeal">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${hasGrievance}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_S20" sourceRef="Gateway_Appeal" targetRef="Gateway_StudentStatus"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_S21" sourceRef="Task_SubmitAppeal" targetRef="Task_MeetAppealsCommittee"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_S22" sourceRef="Task_MeetAppealsCommittee" targetRef="Task_AwaitAppealDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_S23" sourceRef="Task_AwaitAppealDecision" targetRef="Gateway_StudentStatus"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_S24" sourceRef="Gateway_StudentStatus" targetRef="Task_NotifyGraduation">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${graduates}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_S25" sourceRef="Gateway_StudentStatus" targetRef="Task_NotifyWithdrawal">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${withdraws}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_S26" sourceRef="Gateway_StudentStatus" targetRef="Task_SelectCourses"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_S27" sourceRef="Task_NotifyGraduation" targetRef="End_Graduated"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_S28" sourceRef="Task_NotifyWithdrawal" targetRef="End_Withdrawn"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
